TimePeriod: Bronze Age, before and during the conquest
Region: Canaan (their exact territory is not stated in the text)
History: The Girgashites are listed among the sons of Canaan in Genesis 10:16, named in the land promise of Genesis 15:21, counted among the seven nations in Deuteronomy 7:1, and named among the peoples to be driven out before Israel in Joshua 3:10 and Joshua 24:11. Beyond these conquest lists, the Bible records nothing more about them: no king, city, or territory is named for them.
Culture: Unknown beyond their place among the Canaanite peoples of the conquest lists.
Religion: Unknown beyond their place among the peoples whose idolatry Israel was told to reject.
BibleConnection: The Girgashites are a reminder of how little the record preserves about some peoples: they are named in every great list of the land's nations, yet leave no story of their own.
